name: caracara-archicad
description: Work with a running Archicad through the Tapir add-on: find elements, read quantities, and make checked changes with dry runs, a read-only mode and one Undo step per change.

read_only.title: Read-only mode
read_only.description: Let the AI look at your projects but never change, delete, save or export anything.

allow_images.title: Allow pictures of the design
allow_images.description: Let the AI take screenshots of Archicad to check its work. The pictures are uploaded to your AI provider. They help the AI check its work, but each picture uses more tokens and more of the conversation's context. Off by default.

allow_session_commands.title: Allow closing and replacing the open project
allow_session_commands.description: Let the AI close the open project or start a new one. Archicad discards any unsaved changes when that happens, and the AI cannot tell whether you have unsaved work. Off by default; read-only mode still blocks these commands.
